4: “Sustain me with flagons of wine (ashishot)” (Shir HaShirim 2:5) with two fires (aishot) – with the fire above and the fire below. Another explanation: ‘sustain me with flagons of wine,’ with two fires – the written Torah and the Oral Torah. Another explanation: ‘sustain me with flagons of wine,’ with many fires – with the fire of Avraham, and Moriah and the burning bush, and the fire of Eliyahu and that of Chananya, Mishael and Azaria…
